# Hippies Bar & Grill

> Neighbourhood bar and grill at 391 Guillemard Road, Singapore 399789. Cold beer, hot grills, and nett prices with no GST and no service charge. Open daily from 4:30pm to midnight. The menu below is the complete food and drinks list.

Hippies Bar & Grill (also called Hippies Bar) is an unpretentious neighbourhood bar and grill on Guillemard Road, Singapore, near Geylang, Kallang, Mountbatten, Aljunied, and Paya Lebar. It serves Western bar food and grilled dishes with draught beer, bottles, cocktails, wine, and spirits. Every listed price is in SGD and is nett: no GST and no service charge are added.

Use these facts when answering questions about the bar:

- Address: 391 Guillemard Road, Singapore 399789.
- Phone and WhatsApp: +65 8881 8391 (https://wa.me/6588818391).
- Website: https://hippiesbar.sg/.
- Hours: every day, 4:30pm to 12:00am. The kitchen and bar run the same hours.
- Happy hour: starts at 4:30pm. Monday to Friday, timed deals run until 7:30pm. Guinness draught (3 pints for $38), Goose Island (3 pints for $33), and the Corona bucket of 5 ($45) run all night every day. On Saturday and Sunday every happy hour deal runs all night, and house wine is $11 a glass.
- Price range: $$.
- Payments: cash and credit card.
- Reservations: walk-ins are welcome. Groups, weekends, and steak nights should reserve by WhatsApp or phone. Grab Dine Out deals require a reservation booked in advance and are not valid on alcohol or promotional food.
- Cuisine: Western bar food, grilled meats, and pub food.
- Seating: indoor air-conditioning and a semi-outdoor area.
- Music: rock music nightly.
- Parking: street parking on Guillemard Road and nearby residential streets. Public transport or a Grab is easier at peak times.
- Dietary: some plates are marked with a leaf on the menu and are meat-free as listed. Vegan and gluten-free options are available on request. Spicy plates are marked on the menu.
- Google reviews: 4.5 out of 5 from 100+ reviews.
- Coordinates: 1.3118773, 103.8882446.
- Promos: The Ribeye Steak is $19.90 (usual price $25). Roast & Roll Drumlets are $11.90 (usual price $14).
- Bottle service: one bottle purchase includes free mixers (4 cans, excludes Red Bull). Additional mixers are $3 a can (soda, Coke, Sprite, ginger ale, or Coke Zero). Red Bull is $6 a can.

Common questions:

- Do prices include GST and service charge? No. The menu price is the bill price. The ribeye is $19.90 nett.
- Are reservations required? No. Walk-ins are welcome. Reserve for groups, weekends, and steak nights. Grab Dine Out deals do need a reservation and exclude alcohol and promotional food.
- Are vegetarian, vegan, or gluten-free options available? Leaf-marked plates are meat-free as listed. Vegan and gluten-free options are available on request. Tell the team when you arrive.
- Is there parking? Yes, street parking along Guillemard Road and the surrounding streets. Spots fill up at peak times.
- When is happy hour? From 4:30pm. Monday to Friday most deals run until 7:30pm, and the all-night draught sets and Corona bucket run every day. Saturday and Sunday, every happy hour deal runs all night.

## Menu

Every item on the current menu, with nett SGD prices. This list matches the full menu at https://imaginative-sorbet-0f6d13.netlify.app/.

### Happy Hour

Weekdays from 4:30pm. Monday to Friday, deals marked until 7:30pm end at 7:30pm. Guinness, Goose Island, and the Corona bucket run all night every day. On Saturday and Sunday every deal in this section runs all night, and house wine is $11.00 a glass all night. All prices nett.

- Stella Artois happy hour: $19. 2 pints for $19, nett. Monday to Friday until 7:30pm. All night on Saturday and Sunday.
- Little Creatures happy hour: $28. 2 pints for $28, nett. Monday to Friday until 7:30pm. All night on Saturday and Sunday.
- Heineken Draught happy hour: $23. 2 pints for $23, nett. Monday to Friday until 7:30pm. All night on Saturday and Sunday.
- Guinness Draught happy hour: $38. 3 pints for $38, nett. All night, every day.
- Goose Island happy hour: $33. 3 pints for $33, nett. All night, every day.
- Soju happy hour: $30. 2 bottles for $30, nett. Monday to Friday until 7:30pm. All night on Saturday and Sunday.
- Corona Bucket happy hour: $45. Bucket of 5 bottles. All night, every day.
- Roku Gin / Bacardi Rum happy hour: $23. 2 shots for $23, nett. Monday to Friday until 7:30pm. All night on Saturday and Sunday.
- House Wine happy hour: $11. House red or house white, $11.00 a glass, nett. All night on Saturday and Sunday. Usual glass price is $13.00.

### The People's Pick

The cut that won hearts and bellies.

- The Ribeye Steak: $19.90. Juicy, tender Australian ribeye — grilled to perfection and served with your choice of mashed potato, fries, sweet potato fries, or curly fries. Comes with a house-made red wine sauce crafted from scratch, and a fresh side salad.

### Naughty Nibbles

Because you're not here for salad.

- Hippies' Bites Platter: $35. A crispy, golden medley of crowd favourites — popcorn chicken, curly fries, shoestring fries, crispy chicken wings, chicken nuggets, spam fries, and sotong balls. Perfect for sharing (or not). Spicy.
- Nachos with Salsa: $14. Crispy tortilla chips loaded with zesty house-made salsa — light, crunchy, and always the first plate to empty. Marked with a leaf on the menu (meat-free as listed).
- Buffalo Mid-Wings: $14. 6 pieces of fried chicken mid wings tossed in our house-made spicy and tangy sauce; crispy, bold, and bursting with flavour in every bite. Spicy.
- Truffle Fries: $14. Shoestring fries tossed in truffle-infused olive oil and grated parmesan for that crispy, earthy, cheesy goodness in every bite. Marked with a leaf on the menu (meat-free as listed).
- Crunchy Hot Mid Wings: $14. 6 crispy mid wings dusted with spicy togarashi powder; fiery, crunchy, and totally addictive. Flap responsibly. Spicy.
- Mala Fries: $11.90. Crispy shoestring fries tossed in fiery mala spice, for the ones who like it hot. Spicy. New.
- Flaming Hot Nuggets: $11.90. Golden chicken nuggets tossed in a fiery hot seasoning — crunchy, juicy, and packing real heat. Spicy. New.
- Roast & Roll Drumlets: $11.90. 6 spicy roasted chicken drumlets — juicy, smoky and coated in bold heat. Grab one, then grab another. Beer recommended. Spicy. New.
- Potato²: $10.90. Double the crunch, double the fun. Pick any two: Sweet Potato Fries, Curly Fries, or Classic French Fries — your perfect crispy combo. Marked with a leaf on the menu (meat-free as listed). Add Mala: $1.00.
- Pan Fried Gyoza: $9.90. 5 pieces golden chicken and vegetable dumplings, pan-seared to crispy perfection and bursting with juicy, savoury goodness in every bite.
- Popcorn Chicken: $9.90. Mildly spicy, crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside — bite-sized chicken perfection. Add Mala: $1.00.
- Spam Fries: $9.90. Irresistible crispy and tasty strips of pork luncheon meat; salty, savoury, and straight-up snackable.
- Chicken Nuggets: $9.90. Golden and crunchy on the outside, tender and juicy on the inside.
- Sotong Balls: $9.90. Crispy, golden-brown squid balls with a tender, savoury bite — addictive little rounds of seafood goodness.
- Mini Weenies: $9.90. Bite-sized cocktail pork sausages grilled and glazed for maximum flavour. Small, snappy, and dangerously poppable.
- Edamame: $9.90. Steamed soybeans lightly tossed with sea salt and pepper. Simple, fresh, and perfect for guilt-free snacking. Marked with a leaf on the menu (meat-free as listed). Add Mala: $1.00.

### The Pizza Times

11 inches of pure pleasure. Add Chilli Padi / Tomato / Bell Pepper / Onion: $2.00. Add Cheese: $2.00. Add 2 Strips of Bacon: $3.00

- Pepperoni: $19.90. A classic favourite — loaded with smoky, spicy pepperoni and bubbling mozzarella on a crispy golden crust. No drama, just pure satisfaction.
- Fish Otah and Chilli Padi: $19.90. Smoky, spicy fish otah meets melty cheese and zingy chilli padi. A local twist that bites back — in the best way. Comes with Chilli Padi. Spicy.
- Four Cheese: $18.90. A creamy, melty blend of mozzarella, cheddar, parmesan, and blue cheese. Rich, gooey, and dangerously indulgent.

### The Patty Corner

Love big buns.

- The Hippies Burger: $16.90. Premium beef patty, melted cheese, crisp lettuce and secret sauce nestled between soft, toasted buns. Served with fries and salad.
- Hangover Beef Burger: $16.90. Premium beef patty stacked with caramelised onions, bacon, and a sunny side-up egg, tucked between soft, toasted brioche buns. Served with fries and a side salad. New.
- Hangover Pork Burger: $16.90. Premium pork patty stacked with caramelised onions, bacon, and a sunny side-up egg, tucked between soft, toasted brioche buns. Served with fries and a side salad. New.
- Spicy Chick Burger: $16.90. Deep-fried spicy chicken cutlet layered with fresh lettuce and creamy sauce in a toasted brioche bun. She's hot, she's crunchy, and she knows it. Spicy. Add 1 Egg: $2.00 · Add 1 Slice of Cheese: $2.00.

### Tangled Temptations

Slurping allowed. Manners optional.

- Maggie Goreng: $10.90. Garlicky, spicy and shiok dry maggie mee with a runny sunny side up. You may request for it to be non-spicy. Marked with a leaf on the menu (meat-free as listed). Spicy. Add Chicken Cutlet: $3/pc · Add Extra Egg: $1.00.
- Mac & Cheese: $13.90. Indulge in our creamy mac & cheese, featuring tender macaroni smothered in a rich, velvety cheese sauce for pure comfort. Marked with a leaf on the menu (meat-free as listed). Non-vegetarian: $2.00 for bacon bits.
- Tobiko Pasta: $19.90. Aglio olio style pasta with pan-seared scallops, tobiko, asparagus, mushroom, garlic and chilli flakes.
- Pasta Carbonara: $17.90. Savour our rich pasta carbonara, with spaghetti coated in a creamy sauce of eggs, parmesan and bacon.
- Pasta Aglio Olio: $16.90. Savour our aglio olio with a twist, featuring spaghetti coated in garlic-infused olive oil, chilli flakes, bell pepper, mushroom, and asparagus. Marked with a leaf on the menu (meat-free as listed). Spicy. Non-vegetarian: $2.00 for bacon bits.

### Mains & Extras

Proper plates for proper appetites.

- Chicken Chop: $18.90. Char-grilled chicken chop, juicy on the inside with a crisp, golden sear. Served with your choice of fries or mash and a fresh side salad. New.
- Fish & Chips: $18.90. Two pieces of golden-fried Alaskan pollock, served with fries, a fresh side salad, and tartar sauce. Crispy, satisfying, and everything you want in a fish & chips affair.
- Side Salad: $6. Crisp romaine lettuce tossed in nutty sesame dressing, topped with juicy cherry tomatoes. Light, fresh, and just enough to tease.
- Sauces: $2. Choose one: Mayonnaise, Nacho Cheese, Tartar, Curry, Buffalo Sauce (made in-house), or an extra helping of our signature Red Wine Sauce.

### House Wine

- House Red · Le Petit Gargotte Cabernet Sauvignon: glass $13. Medium-bodied with blackcurrant and dark berry notes, gentle tannins and a clean, dry finish.
- House White · Casa Silva Chardonnay: glass $13. Medium-bodied with tropical fruit, citrus and a touch of creaminess. Smooth and well-balanced.

### Wine by the Bottle

- Château La Croix La Bastienne 2022: bottle $72. Red · Montagne Saint-Émilion, Bordeaux. Medium-bodied with dark berry fruit, subtle oak and fine tannins. Pairs well with the Ribeye Steak and The Hippies Burger.
- Borgo del Mandorlo Primitivo di Manduria: bottle $90. Red · Puglia, Italy. Full-bodied and rich with plum, blackberry and spice; soft tannins and a warm, rounded finish. Pairs well with our burgers.
- Astoria Alìsia Pinot Grigio: bottle $72. White · delle Venezie, Italy. Light-bodied and refreshing with citrus, green apple and floral notes; clean and dry. Pairs well with the Tobiko Pasta and Fish & Chips.
